description: This file contains utility functions for grouping and sorting items in the Notesnook project, including key selectors, group array functions, and sort options.

methods.name: getSortValue
methods.description: Returns the sort value for an item based on provided sort options.

methods.name: getSortSelectors
methods.description: Returns sorting functions (ascending and descending) based on sort options.

methods.name: createKeySelector
methods.description: Creates a function to generate group keys for items based on grouping options.

methods.name: groupArray
methods.description: Groups an array of items into a Map based on a key selector function.
